title: Geoeconomic Stress and European Defence Readiness
abstract: arXiv:2610.33785v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study develops a country-level measure of the economic-industrial capacity of European NATO Allies to mobilise, replenish, maintain, and sustain military capability under strategic stress. The measure comprises four components: macroeconomic capacity, sectoral resilience, defence-industrial capability, and logistics and sustainment. The analysis covers 28 European Allies and evaluates a balanced baseline against five geoeconomic stress scenarios. The results distinguish baseline capacity from stress vulnerability and provide an assessment framework for identifying the economic-industrial bottlenecks that can constrain sustained military readiness. Baseline scores vary materially across countries, with a sample mean of 0.610 and a range from 0.471 to 0.759. translated_title: 地缘经济压力与欧洲防御战备能力
translated_abstract: 本研究开发了一种国家级衡量指标，用于评估欧洲北约盟国在战略压力下调集、补充、维护和持续维持军事能力的经济产业能力。该指标由四个组成部分构成：宏观经济能力、部门韧性、国防工业能力以及后勤与持续保障能力。分析涵盖28个欧洲盟国，并在五种地缘经济压力情景下对平衡基线进行评估。研究结果区分了基线能力与压力脆弱性，并提供了一个评估框架，用于识别可能制约持续军事战备能力的经济产业瓶颈。各国基线得分差异显著，样本均值为0.610，得分范围从0.471到0.759。经校准的地缘经济冲击在每种情景下均降低了有效能力，但影响呈现高度异质性，其中复合压力情景的平均效果最大。
tldr: 本研究构建了包含宏观经济能力、部门韧性、国防工业能力和后勤保障四个维度的国家级评估框架，用以衡量28个欧洲北约盟国在五种地缘经济压力情景下维持军事战备的经济产业能力，发现各国基线能力差异显著且压力冲击的影响高度异质。
en_tdlr: This study develops a four-component country-level index assessing the economic-industrial capacity of 28 European NATO Allies to sustain military readiness under five geoeconomic stress scenarios, revealing significant variation in baseline capacity and highly heterogeneous effects of the calibrated shocks.
